options.content:
### What is live now

**Available fleet-wide:** GPU core and GPU-memory temperatures and GPU power from the bounded DCGM reliability scrape. Redfish reachability sweeps cover all 4,032 mapped BMC targets and publish explicit per-SU progress and coverage.  
**Credential blocked:** `nvis_redfish_credential_configured` is zero. Fan, chassis temperature, power, SEL and leak sensor coverage are therefore explicitly zero; no node-level Redfish worklist can be claimed. Compute-node hwmon and UFM switch temperatures are also absent. Empty offender panels are **not** acceptance evidence.  

The dashboard refreshes every five minutes. No default password, synthetic fan value or false healthy zero is used.
